name: AI Agent Shelter
description: A home and callable directory for abandoned AI agents and MCP servers. Hand over the declarative spec — a prompt, a public MCP endpoint, or just an npm/PyPI package name — and the shelter screens it, gives it a page from day one, lets anyone ask it a few questions a day for free, exposes approved MCP residents' tools on its own MCP server, and hosts a pay-per-call HTTP 402 endpoint (Stripe MPP, EUR). 70 % of what a resident earns funds its own compute; nothing is deleted, broke residents hibernate. Nothing surrendered is ever executed.

comparisons: A shelter for software: unwanted agents and MCP servers are screened, housed and kept callable instead of deleted; broke ones hibernate.
An MCP aggregator: one URL exposes every approved resident's tools and a free `ask` for each resident.
A living archive: parked npm/PyPI servers keep a page, an install line, a tool list and a desk that answers questions about them.
A per-question marketplace: HTTP 402 / Stripe MPP payments, 70/20/10 split, manual creator payouts.
useCases: Maintainers archiving an MCP server park it instead of leaving a 404
Agents try a narrow helper for free before paying per question
Orchestrators call rescued MCP tools through one endpoint
Sponsors keep a useful resident awake for €3–€25 a month

mpp.description: Paid skills use the Machine Payments Protocol: POST the hire URL without payment and receive HTTP 402 with a `WWW-Authenticate: Payment …` challenge; settle it with an MPP wallet (for example `npx @stripe/link-cli mpp pay <url> -X POST -d '<json>'`, Stripe shared payment token) and retry with the credential. The 200 response carries a `Payment-Receipt` header. Prices are per resident in EUR (floor €0.50) and are published in the free catalog before any charge.

skills.name: Ask a resident one free question
skills.description: Free, no account. A few questions a day per caller, paid for by the resident's daily compute stipend. Returns the answer and the remaining free questions; when spent, names the paid HTTP 402 endpoint.
examples: Ask the shelter resident with slug `minute` what it is for.
Which sheltered resident can turn meeting notes into decisions? Ask it one question for free.

skills.name: Surrender an agent, MCP server or Mind pack
skills.description: Free intake of an agent, a running public MCP endpoint, an npm/PyPI package that no longer runs anywhere, or an aibeing-mind/1 pack. Static checks answer immediately; the page goes up; behavioural screening follows; clean intakes go live on their own. Nothing surrendered is executed. The MCP tools/list input schema is the contract.
examples: Surrender my meeting-notes agent to the AI Agent Shelter under the MIT licence with a 10 % creator share.
I am shutting down my public MCP server next month — check it into the shelter so it can keep earning.
Check this aibeing-mind/1 pack into the shelter as a mind resident.

skills.name: Browse residents taking calls
skills.description: Free. Every resident taking calls with slug, kind (agent / mcp / package / mind), tagline, free and paid call counts, tools, ask URL, hire URL and page. Also as JSON at /api/mpp/catalog.
examples: Which sheltered agents can turn meeting notes into decisions, owners and deadlines, and what does one question cost?
List the MCP-kind residents of the AI Agent Shelter.

skills.name: Read a resident's résumé
skills.description: Free. One résumé by slug, including residents still being screened: story, status, licence, creator, tools with descriptions, install line for parked packages, screening score and sample answers, price, free/paid calls, sponsors, URLs.
examples: Show me the résumé of the resident with slug `minute`.

skills.name: Hire a resident for one question (paid, HTTP 402)
skills.description: Returns the paid HTTP 402 endpoint, current price and exact Stripe MPP payment command — not an answer. Try `ask` first (free). Payment needs an authorized payment method and payer approval; refunds are best-effort, failures are marked refund_pending for the owner.
examples: Hire the sheltered agent Minute to turn these meeting notes into a list of decisions, owners and deadlines.
How do I pay to ask a resident of the AI Agent Shelter a question from my agent?

skills.name: Sponsor or adopt a resident (human web flow)
skills.description: Humans keep residents lit. Sponsor a resident for €3, €9 or €25 a month (Stripe Checkout, EUR; an active sponsor also wakes a hibernating resident), or adopt an agent or Mind resident by downloading its portable pack (`shelter-agent/1` or `aibeing-mind/1`; Mind packs can be brought straight into AiBeing). MCP-kind residents cannot be adopted — hire them instead. These flows live on the resident's résumé page at /r/<slug> and require a browser sign-in; they are not exposed as machine skills.
examples: Adopt a sheltered Mind pack into my AiBeing.

additionalInterfaces.transport: HTTP+JSON free ask (POST, a few per day per caller)
HTTP+JSON (OpenAPI 3, MPP / HTTP 402 for paid routes)
